title: Anon
tagline: Anonymity guaranteed! Chat, connect, and reveal your identity when you're ready on our dating site. Geeky mode for devs, Crazy mode for diverse matches based on shared interests. Say no to lewd comments! Safe, inclusive, and exciting.
description:
a dating site that prioritizes user anonymity and offers two distinct modes, Geeky and Crazy, catering to different user preferences. In the Geeky mode, users can log in using their GitHub accounts and connect with other developers. In the Crazy mode, users can chat with anyone on the platform based on shared interests.

To ensure a safe and respectful environment, the platform incorporates a monitoring system to identify and handle inappropriate behavior. Lewd comments are strictly monitored, and individuals responsible for such comments will be banned from the platform, maintaining the sanctity of the community.

By allowing users to chat anonymously before revealing their identities, the platform offers a layer of privacy and autonomy to its users. This approach allows individuals to establish connections based on meaningful conversations and shared interests rather than superficial judgments.

Overall, this dating site aims to create a secure, inclusive, and engaging space for individuals to connect with others, fostering relationships that are built on common interests and genuine compatibility.
how_its_made: For the front-end, we used HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.The UI was designed using Figma to ensure an intuitive and visually appealing experience. the platform is still a work in progress. For the Geeky mode, we integrated with the GitHub API, allowing users to log in using their GitHub accounts and retrieve relevant information. For the Crazy mode, we implemented a matching algorithm based on shared interests, leveraging technologies like Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB to handle user profiles, conversations, and data storage. To ensure security and privacy, we will be implementing encryption protocols, such as SSL/TLS, to protect user data during transmission.
